item.title: Sen. Paul threatens to hold Fauci in contempt. And, a new rule undercuts U.S. asylum
item.description: Sen. Rand Paul is moving to hold Dr. Anthony Fauci in contempt of Congress after he invoked his Fifth Amendment rights. And, the Trump administration has announced a new rule for the asylum process.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Russian strikes across Ukraine kill at least 8 civilians and wound dozens
item.description: The blitz expanded Russia's almost daily bombardment of Ukrainian cities as Moscow apparently looked to exploit Kyiv's critical shortage of Western-supplied anti-ballistic missile defenses.

item.title: Pediatricians and health officials are sidestepping Trump's CDC on vaccine advice
item.description: The Trump administration's upending of years of vaccine advice puts many pediatricians in a quandary. Some are steering patients away from the CDC to other authoritative websites, including their own.

item.title: Digital habits that rob attention and energy — and how to combat them
item.description: There's a reason why double- or triple-screening your devices makes you feel tired, says NPR's Manoush Zomorodi. She explains the science of information overload and how to reclaim calm and focus.

item.title: The Lumbee Tribe of N.C. wants better healthcare, but plans to fund it are in limbo
item.description: Robeson County, N.C., where most of the Lumbee Tribe's citizens live, ranks as one of the worst counties in the U.S. for health. The tribe can access the Indian Health Service now, but it's not likely to be sufficient to improve the health of the community.

item.title: The renter-owner wealth gap is wider than ever, as many are priced out of buying
item.description: Housing has long been the largest source of wealth for middle income families. But many renters cannot afford to buy as housing prices soar, which could fuel a generational divide.
